reason: Nothing here hits a problem I have right now, and I buy on impulse when a creator's video does that. Single-form bisglycinate at this price for 2 capsules a day does not beat the multi-form magnesium I can already grab.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when others have 8 forms in one capsule? And $30 a month for it, made in China, from a brand I never heard of.
would_change_my_mind: A creator I follow showing it fixing her sleep, with the lab report on screen, at $19.99 or less for the first box.
